children: Global tokenized stock market total value locked reached $2.55 billion as of last week, while the number of holders surpassed 1 million. According to Foresight News, on-chain trading volume reached $1.7 billion and active traders rose to 235,000.

bStocks accounted for 26% of total value locked and 88% of the market's on-chain trading volume. Ondo held 42% of total value locked and represented 2% of trading volume, while xStocks held 32% of total value locked and accounted for 10% of trading volume.
The data showed that nearly 90% of global tokenized stock trading volume came from bStocks, indicating rising user participation in on-chain stock trading.

title: Tokenized Stock Market TVL Reaches $2.55 Billion as Holders Top 1 Million
